title: Mutation Queue with ACID State Transactions and Configurable State Window
body: All mutations to emulated machine state shall be performed through a mutation queue that provides ACID-like transaction semantics. State changes within a single emulation step (one clock cycle or one instruction) are grouped into a transaction that is either fully applied or fully rolled back. A configurable state window maintains a ring buffer of recent states to support rewind, debugging, and snapshot operations.
